steps.title: Configure App Meta Data
steps.description: Establish the global metadata including name 'SonicWave Lab' and package namespace 'com.sonicwavelab.app'.

steps.title: Define Gradle Project Properties
steps.description: Define build configuration with SDK 34 compile target and Java 17 requirements.

steps.title: Declare App Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Establish proper application manifest structure with correct namespaces and launcher configuration.

steps.title: Build Color Palettes & Styles Resources
steps.description: Design a clean Material theme, layout colors, neon accent tones, and styles for UI elements.

steps.title: Create Core Layout XML
steps.description: Design the main interface with SeekBars for filters, sound triggers, visualizer, dynamic history list, and full loader overlay.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Sound Visualizer View
steps.description: Create custom SoundVisualizerView canvas class that renders live ripple rings and digital waves matching current synth settings.

steps.title: Build SQLite Synth Logger
steps.description: Implement local database schema and helpers to record every generated synth sound, frequency settings, timestamp, and metadata.

steps.title: Implement Core Audio Synth Engine
steps.description: Write custom low-latency PCM synthesizer using AudioTrack SDK API supporting real-time frequency modulations and dynamic sound presets.

steps.title: Integrate Custom Loader & Animated Overlays
steps.description: Implement automated dynamic loading indicators to simulate complex DSP rendering and filter computations upon clicking sound triggers.

steps.title: Wire Animation Framework and Button Scales
steps.description: Attach scaling touch-feedback and visual bounce animations onto control panels, buttons, and custom log rows.

steps.title: Integrate Dynamic Filter Listeners
steps.description: Set up SeekBars for frequency, duration, and echo to update real-time visual tags and synthesize customized waves on-the-fly.

steps.title: Implement Synth Log Recycler & Dynamic Populator
steps.description: Write logic to dynamically inflate and populate custom history layouts with visual tags, dynamic timestamps, and quick play-back triggers.

steps.title: Set Up Sound Termination Safety
steps.description: Ensure proper worker thread execution termination and system resource deallocation upon activity destruction or background pause states.

steps.title: Building SonicWave Lab
steps.description: Compile the completed Android application targeting JDK 17, and output debug packages with dynamic assets fully synthesized.
